checked_claims.note: Poincare duality for the smooth separated DM stack M_{5,8} of dimension d=3*5-3+8=20 identifies H^{BM}_{16} with H^{24}(20). Lowest weight on the ordinary side is W_{24}H^{24}, so W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{5,8};Q)=W_{24}H^{24}(M_{5,8};Q)(20). This is FND-0001 specialized at (5,8), matching the task target (open_bm_degree 16, ordinary_cohomology_degree 24, poincare_twist 20). Stack-level rational Betti/MHS only; no coarse-space or integral identification.

vcd(M_{5,8})=4*5-4+8=24 equals the ordinary degree k=24, and n-1=7 equals the published inclusive endpoint c(5)=7. FND-0195 is stated for g>=2, n>=1, k=vcd, Tate_range n-1<=c(g) with c(5)=7, and excludes only degree vcd-1 of the target and unpublished c(8). The target degree is vcd, not vcd-1. Independently: SRC-0002 Table 1 and Proposition 4.5, THM-0005 (open M, all pure-weight pieces, n<=c(g)), and SRC-0004 Lemma 10.13 ('If n<=7, then M_{5,n} has the CKgP and A^*=R^*') all include n=7.

FND-0195 already concludes that whenever n-1<=c(g) at k=vcd, W_{vcd}H^{vcd}(M_{g,n};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(-vcd/2). Substituting (5,8,24) gives W_{24}H^{24}(M_{5,8};Q)=Q(-12)^{oplus r}. The internal peel reconstruction matches the finding: Phi_{5,8}^{24}=0 because vcd(M_{5,7})=23 and H^{24}(M_{5,7};Q)=0 (strictly above vcd, not the blocked inference at 24=vcd(M_{5,8})); every Kunneth multi-index of C^8->M_5 with |i|<=8 has base degree >=16>vcd(M_5)=15, so the primitive quotient and every no-slot-2 summand vanish; survivors have some i_s=2 and are carried into Psi by FND-0196 (Morita disposal (1) gives b_s=0 for g>=2, and the PTY projector/induction disposals are likewise g-independent); FND-0197 supplies the restriction surjection W_{24}H^{24}(C^8)->W_{24}H^{24}(M_{5,8}) without using the mixed R^1 of the punctured forgetful map. Hodge type enters only through W_{22}H^{22}(M_{5,7};Q): Proposition 4.5 at n=7=c(5) gives algebraicity of every W_k H^k, hence type Q(-11) in even degree 22, and cup with psi of type Q(-1) yields a subquotient of Q(-12). Semisimplicity of polarizable pure weight-24 Hodge structures (inside FND-0195, and the same principle as FND-0033) upgrades that to an honest direct sum. Degree 22=vcd(M_{5,7})-1 is irrelevant: the FND-0195 exclusion of 'degree vcd-1' is about applying the peel at the target, while CKgP/Prop 4.5 has no degree restriction and FND-0195 itself types the source W_{vcd-2}H^{vcd-2}(M_{g,n-1}).

Combine CLM-0138-1 and CLM-0138-3: W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{5,8};Q)=Q(-12)(20)^{oplus r}=Q(8)^{oplus r}. Weight check: Q(-12) has weight 24, twist (20) drops weight by 40 to -16, matching open_bm_weight and open_bm_tate_type. Rank r>=0 is admitted by the theorem (empty sum allowed). No compact-moduli, algebraic-cycle, or tautological-generation upgrade is claimed for H^{16}(Mbar_{5,8}).

The argument never invokes the boundary sequence of THM-0003, Aut(Gamma)-invariants or coinvariants, or any Kunneth term of hat{partial}Mbar_{5,8} or hat{partial}Mbar_{6,6}. The theorem_statement itself disclaims H^{16}(Mbar_{5,8};Q) and the campaign boundary-image theorem; the writeup matches that scope.

finding_candidates.statement: In the closed-universal-curve vcd peel at (g,n,k)=(5,8,24), Harer vanishing of the primitive term (base degree 16>15) and of Phi_{5,8}^{24} (24>23) yields only the generation statement W_{24}H^{24}(M_{5,8};Q)=Psi_{5,8}^{24}, which is type-free. All Hodge type enters through the single instance W_{22}H^{22}(M_{5,7};Q)=Q(-11)^a, i.e. THM-0005/FND-0195 at the boundary value n-1=7=c(5), applied to the open stack at degree vcd(M_{5,7})-1. Consequently the (5,8) Tate conclusion via this route has zero slack in the CKgP table: any downward revision of c(5) to 6, or any restriction of THM-0005 from open M_{g,n} to Mbar_{g,n}, refutes the conclusion without touching any other step. Reviewers should treat that one instance, not the peel combinatorics, as the locus of risk.

strongest_attack: The strongest attack is that all Hodge type in the (5,8) peel is carried by one zero-slack CKgP instance, while the rest of the argument is type-free generation. Harer kills the primitive term (base degree 16>vcd(M_5)=15) and Phi_{5,8}^{24} (24>vcd(M_{5,7})=23), so W_{24}H^{24}(M_{5,8};Q)=Psi_{5,8}^{24}, which could a priori be an arbitrary polarizable pure weight-24 structure. Type enters only at W_{22}H^{22}(M_{5,7};Q)=Q(-11)^a, i.e. THM-0005/FND-0195 at n-1=7=c(5) on the OPEN stack, at degree 22=vcd(M_{5,7})-1. There is no slack: if c(5) were 6, or if the bound concerned Mbar_{5,n} rather than open M_{5,n}, or if CKgP-to-pure-weight algebraicity cost one marking, the theorem would fail with no other step disturbed. This attack was pressed and fails. THM-0005 records object 'open M', degree 'all pure-weight pieces', n<=c(g) with c(5)=7, established and unconditional; SRC-0004 Lemma 10.13 is the inclusive statement 'If n<=7, then M_{5,n} has the CKgP and A^*=R^*'; SRC-0002 Lemma 4.3 then Proposition 4.5 type W_{22}H^{22} as algebraic Hodge-Tate Q(-11); FND-0195 independently records Tate_range n-1<=c(g) and already concludes the direct-sum statement at this endpoint. The adjacent overreach of applying CKgP at n=8 is not committed. Second attack, the FND-0196 slot-1 cross term b_s: fails because Morita's rational vanishing H^1(Mod_g;H^1(Sigma_g;Q))=0 holds for all g>=2, hence at g=5, so b_s=0 identically. Third attack, treating FND-0195 as a (6,6)-only finding: fails because the corroborated statement is for g>=2, n>=1, k=vcd, and names c(5)=7. Remaining surfaces checked clean: Poincare duality and every twist (d=20, 2d-16=24, Q(-12)(20)=Q(8), weight -16); Gysin unused; Kunneth base-degree bookkeeping 24-|i|>=16>15 for |i|<=8, with eight slots in {0,1,2} forcing some i_s=2 once |i|>=9; degeneration versus splitting (Leray of the smooth proper closed universal curve C^8->M_5, not the mixed R^1 of the punctured forgetful map); semisimplification versus isomorphism (purity plus polarizability of the lowest-weight piece, as in FND-0033/FND-0195); stack versus coarse and Q versus Z (no coarse or integral identification); graph-automorphism invariants versus coinvariants (no boundary or Aut(Gamma) appears); predicted motives used as theorems (none; algebraicity is supplied by CKgP before any Tate claim); omitted stable pairs (the theorem is only the (5,8) open residual); FND-0035's blocked vcd-vanishing inference at 24=vcd(M_{5,8}) is absent.
